description: Municipal Producer Question Library for WAYOS PREP

questions.question_text: What is the department's current use-of-force policy and when was it last updated?
questions.purpose: Assess whether the use-of-force policy meets current legal standards and best practices
follow_up_questions: How often is use-of-force training conducted?
How are force incidents reviewed and documented?

questions.question_text: How many Section 1983 civil rights claims has the department received in the past 5 years?
questions.purpose: Quantify historical civil rights litigation exposure
follow_up_questions: What were the outcomes?
What is the average cost per claim?

questions.question_text: Does the department operate body-worn cameras on all patrol officers?
questions.purpose: Evaluate evidence preservation practices and litigation defense capability
follow_up_questions: What is the retention policy for footage?
Who reviews footage after incidents?

questions.question_text: What is the current pursuit driving policy?
questions.purpose: Identify high-severity auto liability from pursuit-related accidents
follow_up_questions: How many pursuit incidents occurred last year?
Were any third parties injured?

questions.question_text: How are officer misconduct complaints received, investigated, and resolved?
questions.purpose: Assess internal affairs process and early warning systems for problem officers
follow_up_questions: Is there a citizen complaint review board?
How many sustained complaints in the last 3 years?

questions.question_text: What training does the department provide on de-escalation techniques?
questions.purpose: Identify whether de-escalation training reduces force incidents and associated claims
follow_up_questions: How many hours of de-escalation training per year?
Is training scenario-based?

questions.question_text: Does the department operate a K-9 unit and what is the bite/force policy?
questions.purpose: K-9 deployments generate significant excessive force and civil rights claims
follow_up_questions: How many K-9 deployments per year?
How many bite incidents in the last 3 years?

questions.question_text: What is the department's policy on off-duty employment by officers?
questions.purpose: Off-duty incidents can create municipality liability if officer is acting under color of law
follow_up_questions: Does the municipality require approval for secondary employment?
Who provides liability coverage for off-duty work?

questions.question_text: How is evidence handled and stored, including digital evidence?
questions.purpose: Spoliation of evidence and chain-of-custody failures create litigation exposure
follow_up_questions: Is there a digital evidence management system?
What is the evidence retention schedule?

questions.question_text: What mental health and wellness programs are available for officers?
questions.purpose: Officer wellness impacts judgment, force decisions, and workers comp claims
follow_up_questions: Is there a peer support program?
What is the PTSD claim rate?

questions.question_text: Does the department operate a detention facility or holding cells?
questions.purpose: In-custody injuries and deaths create extreme liability exposure
follow_up_questions: What is the medical screening process for detainees?
Have there been any in-custody incidents?

questions.question_text: How many officers are on the force and what is the annual turnover rate?
questions.purpose: Staffing levels and turnover impact training adequacy and incident rates
follow_up_questions: Are you fully staffed?
What is the average officer tenure?

questions.question_text: What is the SWAT/tactical team deployment frequency and training schedule?
questions.purpose: Tactical operations carry elevated excessive force and property damage exposure
follow_up_questions: Is the team shared with other agencies?
What equipment is used (armored vehicles, flash bangs)?

questions.question_text: How does the department handle interactions with individuals experiencing mental health crises?
questions.purpose: Mental health crisis encounters are a leading source of force complaints and wrongful death claims
follow_up_questions: Is there a co-responder model with mental health professionals?
How many CIT-trained officers are on staff?

questions.question_text: What is the vehicle accident rate for the patrol fleet?
questions.purpose: Police vehicles have high mileage and emergency response creates elevated accident frequency
follow_up_questions: How many preventable accidents last year?
Are dash cameras standard?

questions.question_text: What policies govern social media use by officers both on and off duty?
questions.purpose: Officer social media activity can create civil rights and employment practices claims
follow_up_questions: Have there been any social media-related disciplinary actions?

questions.question_text: Does the department have a citizen ride-along program?
questions.purpose: Ride-along participants create additional liability if injured during operations
follow_up_questions: What waivers are required?
What is the screening process?

questions.question_text: What is the department's asset forfeiture process and volume?
questions.purpose: Civil asset forfeiture generates litigation and constitutional challenge claims
follow_up_questions: What is the annual forfeiture value?
How many forfeiture challenges are pending?

questions.question_text: How are high-risk warrants (no-knock, narcotics) planned and executed?
questions.purpose: High-risk warrants carry extreme liability for force, property damage, and wrongful death
follow_up_questions: How many high-risk warrants were executed last year?
What supervisory approval is required?

questions.question_text: What training and certification do firefighters maintain beyond basic firefighting?
questions.purpose: Training certifications (hazmat, technical rescue, EMS) affect exposure scope
follow_up_questions: What percentage are paramedic vs EMT certified?
Is hazmat response provided?

questions.question_text: Does the fire department use volunteer firefighters and what coverage applies to them?
questions.purpose: Volunteer firefighter injuries create unique coverage and liability questions
follow_up_questions: How many volunteers vs career firefighters?
Are volunteers covered under the municipality's WC policy?

questions.question_text: What is the fire department's annual call volume and breakdown by type (fire, EMS, hazmat, rescue)?
questions.purpose: Call volume and type directly impact workers comp frequency and fleet exposure
follow_up_questions: What percentage of calls are EMS vs fire?
What is the mutual aid arrangement with neighboring departments?

questions.question_text: What apparatus and vehicles does the fire department operate?
questions.purpose: Fire apparatus are high-value vehicles with elevated collision severity during emergency response
follow_up_questions: What is the average apparatus age?
What is the replacement schedule?

questions.question_text: How does the department manage cancer screening and occupational disease exposure for firefighters?
questions.purpose: Firefighter occupational cancer is a growing workers comp exposure with presumptive legislation in many states
follow_up_questions: Does the state have a firefighter cancer presumption law?
What exposure tracking and decontamination protocols are in place?

questions.question_text: What is the fire department's live fire training frequency and safety protocol?
questions.purpose: Training injuries are a significant WC exposure — live fire training carries burn and smoke inhalation risk
follow_up_questions: Is training conducted at a fixed facility or acquired structures?
Have there been any training injuries in the past 3 years?

questions.question_text: Does the fire department provide EMS/ambulance transport services?
questions.purpose: EMS transport adds medical malpractice, patient handling, and ambulance collision exposure
follow_up_questions: What is the billing and reimbursement model?
How many patient transport runs per year?

questions.question_text: What PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) exposure exists from firefighting foam?
questions.purpose: PFAS contamination from AFFF foam creates both environmental liability and firefighter health claims
follow_up_questions: Has AFFF been used at training facilities?
Has groundwater testing been conducted at fire stations?

questions.question_text: What is the fire department's mutual aid agreement scope?
questions.purpose: Mutual aid responses in other jurisdictions can create workers comp and liability coverage gaps
follow_up_questions: How many mutual aid responses per year?
Does the agreement address liability and WC coverage?

questions.question_text: What physical fitness and wellness program exists for firefighters?
questions.purpose: Cardiovascular events are a leading cause of firefighter line-of-duty deaths and WC claims
follow_up_questions: Are annual physicals required?
What is the cardiac event history?

questions.question_text: How does the department handle fire code inspections and enforcement?
questions.purpose: Failure to inspect or enforce fire codes can create liability when fires cause injuries or deaths
follow_up_questions: How many inspections per year?
What is the re-inspection process for violations?

questions.question_text: How many lane-miles of roads does the municipality maintain?
questions.purpose: Road mileage directly correlates with pothole and road defect claim frequency
follow_up_questions: What is the annual paving/resurfacing budget?
What is the pavement condition index?

questions.question_text: How are road defects (potholes, sinkholes, shoulder erosion) reported, tracked, and repaired?
questions.purpose: Response time to known road defects is the key factor in pothole liability claims
follow_up_questions: What is the average repair time after a defect is reported?
Is there a digital tracking system?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's snow and ice removal plan and response time standard?
questions.purpose: Snow/ice response standards and documentation are critical defenses against winter weather claims
follow_up_questions: What is the priority route system?
How many plows and salt trucks are available?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality manage stormwater infrastructure and flood control?
questions.purpose: Stormwater system failures cause property damage claims and environmental compliance issues
follow_up_questions: What is the stormwater system age?
Has the system capacity been assessed for current development levels?

questions.question_text: How are traffic signals and street lights maintained and inspected?
questions.purpose: Signal failures and burned-out lights contribute to intersection accidents and municipal liability
follow_up_questions: What is the inspection frequency?
What is the response time for reported outages?

questions.question_text: Does the municipality operate a bridge inventory and what is the inspection schedule?
questions.purpose: Bridge failures create catastrophic liability — regular inspection documentation is critical
follow_up_questions: How many bridges are weight-restricted or structurally deficient?
What is the funding plan for bridge replacements?

questions.question_text: What trenching and excavation work does public works perform and what safety protocols are in place?
questions.purpose: Trench collapses are a leading cause of construction fatalities — OSHA standards are strict
follow_up_questions: Is a competent person designated for every excavation?
What shoring/trench box equipment is available?

questions.question_text: How are work zones set up and managed for road construction and maintenance?
questions.purpose: Work zone safety affects both worker injuries and motorist claims from improper traffic control
follow_up_questions: Do you follow MUTCD standards?
How many work zone incidents occurred last year?

questions.question_text: What is the public works fleet composition and maintenance program?
questions.purpose: Dump trucks, heavy equipment, and utility vehicles create elevated auto and property damage exposure
follow_up_questions: What is the average fleet age?
What is the preventive maintenance schedule?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality handle sidewalk maintenance — is it a city or property owner responsibility?
questions.purpose: Sidewalk trip-and-fall claims are high-frequency — liability allocation varies by ordinance
follow_up_questions: What is the sidewalk inspection program?
How are ADA compliance issues handled?

questions.question_text: What confined space entry operations does the department perform?
questions.purpose: Sewer manholes, water vaults, and tanks are permit-required confined spaces with atmospheric and engulfment hazards
follow_up_questions: How many confined space entries per year?
What atmospheric monitoring equipment is used?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality manage street tree maintenance and removal?
questions.purpose: Falling tree limbs on public property create both GL and WC claims
follow_up_questions: Is there a tree inventory and inspection program?
How are dead/hazardous trees identified and removed?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) compliance status for public infrastructure?
questions.purpose: ADA non-compliance in sidewalks, curb ramps, and public buildings creates federal civil rights exposure
follow_up_questions: Is there an ADA transition plan?
What percentage of curb ramps are ADA compliant?

questions.question_text: How are herbicides and pesticides managed for right-of-way maintenance?
questions.purpose: Chemical application near waterways and residential areas creates environmental and health claims
follow_up_questions: Are applicators licensed?
What chemicals are used and how is drift managed?

questions.question_text: What is the annual number of sewer backup claims the municipality receives?
questions.purpose: Sewer backup claim frequency and severity indicates system condition and maintenance adequacy
follow_up_questions: What is the average claim cost?
What is the sewer line cleaning schedule?

questions.question_text: What utility locate and call-before-you-dig procedures are in place?
questions.purpose: Striking underground utilities during excavation creates property damage and service disruption claims
follow_up_questions: How many utility strikes occurred last year?
What GIS mapping exists for underground infrastructure?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality manage pavement markings and signage maintenance?
questions.purpose: Faded markings and missing signs contribute to accident liability
follow_up_questions: What is the restriping schedule?
How are sign replacements prioritized?

questions.question_text: What is the condition and age of the water distribution system?
questions.purpose: Aging water mains create water main break claims and water quality contamination exposure
follow_up_questions: What percentage of the system is beyond its design life?
How many water main breaks per year?

questions.question_text: What dam safety responsibilities does the municipality have?
questions.purpose: Dam failures create catastrophic downstream liability
follow_up_questions: What hazard classification are the dams?
When was the last dam safety inspection?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's capital improvement plan for infrastructure replacement?
questions.purpose: Deferred maintenance increases claim frequency — the CIP indicates investment in risk reduction
follow_up_questions: What is the annual capital budget?
How is the CIP prioritized?

questions.question_text: What water treatment processes are used and what chemicals are stored on site?
questions.purpose: Water treatment chemical storage and handling creates both worker safety and environmental exposure
follow_up_questions: What quantities of chlorine or other chemicals are stored?
What is the emergency response plan for a chemical release?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's compliance record with Safe Drinking Water Act requirements?
questions.purpose: SDWA violations create regulatory penalties and class action exposure from affected customers
follow_up_questions: Have there been any maximum contaminant level violations?
When was the last sanitary survey?

questions.question_text: What is the lead service line inventory status and replacement plan?
questions.purpose: EPA Lead and Copper Rule revisions require lead service line inventories — failure creates health exposure
follow_up_questions: How many known lead service lines exist?
What is the replacement timeline and funding source?

questions.question_text: What is the wastewater treatment plant's NPDES permit compliance history?
questions.purpose: Discharge permit violations create EPA enforcement actions and citizen lawsuits
follow_up_questions: Have there been any permit exceedances in the last 3 years?
What is the consent order status if any?

questions.question_text: What is the sanitary sewer overflow (SSO) frequency and response protocol?
questions.purpose: SSO events create environmental penalties and property damage claims simultaneously
follow_up_questions: How many SSOs were reported last year?
What is the root cause (capacity, blockage, infiltration)?

questions.question_text: Does the utility operate any electric generation or distribution assets?
questions.purpose: Electric utility operations create electrocution, fire, and infrastructure failure exposures
follow_up_questions: What is the system voltage and line-mile count?
How many outage events per year?

questions.question_text: What SCADA and operational technology systems control water/sewer operations?
questions.purpose: SCADA systems are targets for cyber attacks that could compromise water treatment and public health
follow_up_questions: Are SCADA systems air-gapped or network-connected?
When was the last OT security assessment?

questions.question_text: What is the inflow and infiltration (I&I) status of the sewer collection system?
questions.purpose: Excessive I&I causes capacity-related sewer backups during rain events and increases treatment costs
follow_up_questions: What percentage of the collection system has been assessed with CCTV?
What is the annual I&I reduction budget?

questions.question_text: What emergency contingency plan exists for water system failure?
questions.purpose: Loss of water supply is a public health emergency — contingency plans affect business interruption and liability
follow_up_questions: Are there emergency interconnections with adjacent systems?
What is the emergency water supply capacity?

questions.question_text: How does the utility manage biosolids disposal from wastewater treatment?
questions.purpose: Biosolids land application creates environmental liability and neighbor complaints
follow_up_questions: What is the disposal method (land application, landfill, incineration)?
Are there any citizen complaints about odor?

questions.question_text: What is the utility's customer meter reading and billing dispute process?
questions.purpose: Billing disputes and service disconnection claims create customer relations and legal exposure
follow_up_questions: How many billing disputes per year?
What is the disconnection policy for non-payment?

questions.question_text: What utility rate increase process and public hearing requirements apply?
questions.purpose: Rate setting decisions can generate legal challenges and public officials claims
follow_up_questions: When was the last rate study conducted?
Are rates adequate to fund infrastructure replacement?

questions.question_text: Does the utility have cross-connection control and backflow prevention programs?
questions.purpose: Cross-connections can introduce contaminants into the drinking water system
follow_up_questions: How many backflow prevention devices are in service?
What is the testing compliance rate?

questions.question_text: How often are playground inspections performed and documented?
questions.purpose: Identify maintenance practices that reduce injury exposure at municipal playgrounds
follow_up_questions: Who is responsible for inspection logs?
How are hazards reported and corrected?

questions.question_text: Does playground equipment meet current CPSC and ASTM safety standards?
questions.purpose: Outdated equipment that fails current safety standards increases liability when injuries occur
follow_up_questions: When was the last equipment replacement cycle?
What surfacing materials are used under equipment?

questions.question_text: What aquatic facilities (pools, splash pads, water parks) does the department operate?
questions.purpose: Aquatic facilities carry drowning and slip-and-fall liability exposure
follow_up_questions: What lifeguard staffing and certification requirements exist?
How many incidents occurred last season?

questions.question_text: How many public events, festivals, and concerts does the municipality sponsor annually?
questions.purpose: Public events create crowd crush, alcohol-related, and vendor liability exposure
follow_up_questions: What insurance requirements exist for event vendors?
Is alcohol served at events?

questions.question_text: What youth sports and recreation programs does the municipality operate?
questions.purpose: Youth programs create participant injury, coaching liability, and abuse/molestation exposure
follow_up_questions: Are background checks conducted on all coaches and volunteers?
What is the concussion management protocol?

questions.question_text: What trail systems and greenways does the municipality maintain?
questions.purpose: Trail conditions, signage, and maintenance create trip-and-fall and inadequate warning claims
follow_up_questions: What is the trail inspection frequency?
Are trails used for cycling and what are the speed limits?

questions.question_text: What rental facilities (community centers, shelters, fields) does the department manage?
questions.purpose: Facility rentals create premises liability and tenant-use exposure
follow_up_questions: What insurance requirements apply to renters?
Are hold-harmless agreements used?

questions.question_text: Does the parks department manage any natural areas with hiking, boating, or swimming?
questions.purpose: Natural areas create drowning, wildlife encounter, and rescue operation exposure
follow_up_questions: Are there lifeguards at swimming areas?
What signage exists for hazard warnings?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality screen volunteers who work with children in recreation programs?
questions.purpose: Inadequate background screening creates abuse/molestation liability exposure
follow_up_questions: Are criminal background checks conducted on all volunteers?
What is the supervision ratio policy?

questions.question_text: What athletic field maintenance practices are used (turf management, field conditions)?
questions.purpose: Poor field conditions contribute to participant injuries and premises liability claims
follow_up_questions: How often are fields inspected pre-game?
What is the policy for closing fields due to conditions?

questions.question_text: Does the department operate a golf course and what are the unique exposures?
questions.purpose: Golf courses create errant ball, lightning, cart accident, and chemical application exposure
follow_up_questions: What is the annual round count?
Are golf carts rented to patrons?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's governmental immunity status under state tort claims law?
questions.purpose: Governmental immunity is the foundational liability framework — understanding caps and exceptions is critical
follow_up_questions: What is the damages cap per occurrence?
What activities are not covered by immunity?

questions.question_text: What is the current structure of the governing body and how are decisions documented?
questions.purpose: Governance structure and documentation practices affect public officials liability exposure
follow_up_questions: Are all meetings conducted in compliance with open meetings laws?
What training do elected officials receive?

questions.question_text: What employment practices policies exist (anti-harassment, anti-discrimination, grievance procedures)?
questions.purpose: Public sector EPLI claims are common — policies, training, and documentation are key defenses
follow_up_questions: When was the employee handbook last updated?
How many employment-related claims in the past 3 years?

questions.question_text: What is the total municipal payroll and how is it distributed across departments?
questions.purpose: Payroll distribution by department drives WC premium allocation and indicates exposure concentration
follow_up_questions: What are the highest-payroll departments?
How much payroll is allocated to public safety?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality manage public records requests and FOIA compliance?
questions.purpose: FOIA non-compliance creates litigation and can result in fee-shifting awards
follow_up_questions: What is the average response time for records requests?
Have there been any FOIA lawsuits?

questions.question_text: What cybersecurity measures protect municipal IT systems and data?
questions.purpose: Municipal governments are primary targets for ransomware — cyber hygiene directly impacts claim likelihood
follow_up_questions: Is there a cybersecurity incident response plan?
When was the last penetration test?

questions.question_text: Does the municipality carry cyber liability insurance and what are the limits?
questions.purpose: Determine whether current cyber coverage is adequate for ransomware and data breach scenarios
follow_up_questions: What is the retention/deductible?
Does the policy cover ransomware payments?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's approach to risk management — is there a dedicated risk manager?
questions.purpose: A dedicated risk manager indicates organizational maturity in loss prevention
follow_up_questions: What risk management initiatives have been implemented?
Is risk management centralized or decentralized?

questions.question_text: What interlocal agreements or joint ventures does the municipality participate in?
questions.purpose: Interlocal agreements create shared liability and coverage coordination requirements
follow_up_questions: Do agreements address insurance and indemnification?
What joint services are provided?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality manage contracts and insurance requirements for third-party vendors?
questions.purpose: Inadequate vendor insurance requirements create uninsured liability gaps
follow_up_questions: What minimum insurance limits are required?
Is additional insured status required?

questions.question_text: What federal and state grants is the municipality currently managing?
questions.purpose: Grant non-compliance can result in fund clawback and audit findings
follow_up_questions: What is the total grant portfolio value?
When was the last single audit conducted?

questions.question_text: What is the competitive bidding threshold and procurement process?
questions.purpose: Procurement violations create bid protest litigation and public trust issues
follow_up_questions: How many bid protests have been filed in the past 3 years?
What electronic bidding system is used?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's approach to land use planning and zoning decisions?
questions.purpose: Zoning and land use decisions generate inverse condemnation, takings, and equal protection claims
follow_up_questions: How many zoning appeals are pending?
Has the municipality faced any takings claims?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality handle building code enforcement and inspections?
questions.purpose: Building inspection failures that result in structural collapse or injury create significant liability
follow_up_questions: How many building inspectors are on staff?
What is the inspection backlog?

questions.question_text: What solid waste collection services does the municipality provide?
questions.purpose: Sanitation trucks operating in residential areas create pedestrian strike, property damage, and worker injury exposure
follow_up_questions: Is collection performed in-house or contracted?
How many collection routes per day?

questions.question_text: How many workers comp claims does sanitation generate annually?
questions.purpose: Sanitation has among the highest WC claim rates of any municipal department — lifting, struck-by, and vehicle incidents
follow_up_questions: What are the most common injury types?
Are automated collection trucks used?

questions.question_text: What recycling operations does the municipality manage?
questions.purpose: Recycling processing creates additional worker exposure to sharps, chemicals, and equipment hazards
follow_up_questions: Is there a municipal recycling center?
What contamination issues exist with the recycling stream?

questions.question_text: Does the municipality operate a landfill or transfer station?
questions.purpose: Landfill operations create environmental compliance, closure liability, and worker safety exposure
follow_up_questions: What is the remaining permitted capacity?
What is the estimated closure and post-closure cost?

questions.question_text: What is the sanitation fleet composition and accident history?
questions.purpose: Garbage trucks have high claim frequency due to residential area operation and backing incidents
follow_up_questions: How many backing accidents last year?
Are rear-mounted cameras standard?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality handle illegal dumping and code enforcement for waste?
questions.purpose: Illegal dumping enforcement and cleanup creates environmental and legal expense exposure
follow_up_questions: How many illegal dumping complaints per year?
What is the cleanup cost recovery process?

questions.question_text: What hazardous waste collection events or programs does the municipality offer?
questions.purpose: Hazardous waste handling creates worker exposure and environmental contamination risk
follow_up_questions: How often are events held?
What contractor handles hazardous waste transport and disposal?

questions.question_text: What street sweeping program exists and how does it relate to stormwater compliance?
questions.purpose: Street sweeping is a stormwater BMP (best management practice) — frequency affects permit compliance
follow_up_questions: What is the sweeping schedule?
How many sweeping miles per year?

questions.question_text: How is the annual paving program prioritized?
questions.purpose: Systematic paving prioritization demonstrates reasonable maintenance for liability defense
follow_up_questions: What pavement management system is used?
What is the average pavement condition index?

questions.question_text: What is the response time standard for emergency road repairs?
questions.purpose: Documented response time standards are a key defense element in pothole and defect claims
follow_up_questions: How is an emergency repair defined?
Are response times tracked and reported?

questions.question_text: How are curb and gutter repairs managed?
questions.purpose: Damaged curbs and gutters create trip-and-fall hazards and stormwater drainage issues
follow_up_questions: What is the annual repair budget?
How are repair requests prioritized?

questions.question_text: What right-of-way encroachment and utility coordination issues exist?
questions.purpose: Utility cuts and encroachments degrade pavement and create liability for road conditions
follow_up_questions: What right-of-way permit process exists?
How are utility cut restorations inspected?

questions.question_text: What is the street department's fleet size and heavy equipment inventory?
questions.purpose: Heavy equipment operation on public roads creates heightened collision and property damage exposure
follow_up_questions: What is the average equipment age?
What is the CDL compliance rate for operators?

questions.question_text: How does the street department manage drainage ditch and culvert maintenance?
questions.purpose: Clogged drainage creates flooding claims against the municipality
follow_up_questions: What is the ditch cleaning schedule?
How are drainage complaints tracked and resolved?

questions.question_text: How are water quality test results communicated to the public?
questions.purpose: Failure to properly notify customers of water quality issues creates regulatory and legal exposure
follow_up_questions: Is the annual Consumer Confidence Report published on time?
What is the boil water advisory notification process?

questions.question_text: What redundancy exists in the water treatment process?
questions.purpose: Single points of failure in water treatment can cause public health emergencies
follow_up_questions: Is there backup power generation?
What is the treated water storage capacity?

questions.question_text: What operator certifications do water treatment staff hold?
questions.purpose: Operator certification is a regulatory requirement — staffing shortages can cause compliance violations
follow_up_questions: Are certifications current?
How many operators are needed vs available?

questions.question_text: What source water protection measures are in place?
questions.purpose: Source water contamination creates treatment challenges and potential health impacts
follow_up_questions: Is there a source water protection plan?
What potential contamination sources exist in the watershed?

questions.question_text: What is the total municipal fleet size across all departments?
questions.purpose: Fleet size directly correlates with auto liability exposure and premium
follow_up_questions: What is the fleet breakdown by department?
What vehicle types are included?

questions.question_text: What is the fleet preventive maintenance program and schedule?
questions.purpose: Preventive maintenance reduces mechanical failure accidents and demonstrates reasonable care
follow_up_questions: What fleet management software is used?
What is the PM compliance rate?

questions.question_text: How are driver qualifications and MVRs managed across the fleet?
questions.purpose: Unqualified or problem drivers create negligent entrustment liability
follow_up_questions: How often are MVRs pulled?
What is the process for revoking driving privileges?

questions.question_text: What is the municipal fleet accident history for the past 3 years?
questions.purpose: Historical accident data indicates fleet risk profile and loss trend
follow_up_questions: What are the most common accident types?
What is the average claim cost?

questions.question_text: Does the fleet include electric or alternative fuel vehicles?
questions.purpose: EV charging infrastructure and battery fire exposure are emerging fleet risks
follow_up_questions: How many EVs are in the fleet?
What charging infrastructure exists?

questions.question_text: What driver training program exists for municipal vehicle operators?
questions.purpose: Formal driver training reduces accident frequency and supports litigation defense
follow_up_questions: Is defensive driving training required?
How often is refresher training conducted?

questions.question_text: Are GPS tracking and telematics installed on municipal vehicles?
questions.purpose: Telematics data supports accident investigation and identifies risky driving behavior
follow_up_questions: What percentage of fleet has telematics?
Is data reviewed regularly?

questions.question_text: What is the vehicle replacement schedule and average fleet age?
questions.purpose: Aging fleet increases maintenance costs, breakdown risk, and safety feature gaps
follow_up_questions: What is the average vehicle age by category?
What is the annual replacement budget?

questions.question_text: How does the municipality handle personal use of municipal vehicles?
questions.purpose: Take-home vehicle policies create after-hours liability and personal use exposure
follow_up_questions: How many vehicles are assigned take-home?
What is the personal use policy?

questions.question_text: What fleet fueling infrastructure does the municipality operate?
questions.purpose: Above-ground and underground fuel storage creates environmental contamination liability
follow_up_questions: Are tanks above-ground or underground?
What leak detection systems are in place?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's overall workers compensation experience modification rate?
questions.purpose: The mod rate is the single best indicator of historical loss performance vs industry peers
follow_up_questions: What is the mod trend over the past 3 years?
Which departments drive the most claims?

questions.question_text: What return-to-work program exists for injured municipal employees?
questions.purpose: Return-to-work programs are the most effective mod improvement tool available
follow_up_questions: What light duty positions are available?
What is the average days-away rate?

questions.question_text: What is the municipality's total claim count and incurred losses for the past 5 years?
questions.purpose: Loss history is the foundation of underwriting — trending data reveals improvement or deterioration
follow_up_questions: Can you provide a loss run by line of coverage?
What are the open claim reserves?

questions.question_text: Does the municipality participate in an insurance pool or purchase coverage independently?
questions.purpose: Pool membership vs commercial market placement affects coverage structure, limits, and pricing
follow_up_questions: What pool services are included (loss control, claims management)?
What is the pool's financial condition?

questions.question_text: What self-insured retention (SIR) or deductible levels apply across lines of coverage?
questions.purpose: SIR levels indicate the municipality's retained risk and claims management responsibility
follow_up_questions: Is a third-party administrator used for retained claims?
